about: The shared parts of the CI of CrankyAnt/SharedWorkflows that a consumer can adopt. Read this file at the tag v1. Paths are paths in CrankyAnt/SharedWorkflows at v1: a workflow is called as CrankyAnt/SharedWorkflows/.github/workflows/<workflow>@v1 and a step as CrankyAnt/SharedWorkflows/actions/<part>@v1. required_checks are the checks a consumer's default-branch ruleset requires for the part. consumer_kit is the folder that holds the part's caller templates and their explanation in its README.md, or null while the part has no consumer kit yet. A consumer applies shared parts and changes none of them.

parts.name: Repository hygiene
parts.purpose: One job that checks every repository's publication conventions and credentials and runs the shared checks that a change can affect: workflow validation, Dependabot coverage, relative Markdown links and REUSE.
parts.needs: A GitHub repository whose squash and merge-commit subjects are the pull request title with an empty body and whose rebase merge is disabled.
parts.applies: Every repository, a Markdown-only one included.

parts.name: Dependabot auto-merge
parts.purpose: Merges a Dependabot pull request whose updates are all patch or minor, and for GitHub Actions all from actions/*, once its required checks have passed.
parts.needs: A Dependabot configuration, Dependabot alerts and security updates enabled, and a default-branch ruleset that requires status checks.
parts.applies: A repository with a dependency of its own: a package file that Dependabot updates, or a workflow of its own, other than a caller of a shared workflow, that uses an action from outside the repository.

parts.name: Suite selection
parts.purpose: Runs only the test suites and entry files that a change can affect, from path lists recorded by the recording step, and reports one verdict as the required check.
parts.needs: A validation workflow that runs the repository's suites on pull requests and pushes, a suite list of those suites, and for the full recording a GitHub App that may open pull requests.
parts.applies: A repository whose test suites take long enough that running only the affected ones saves more than the selection costs.

parts.name: Python language step
parts.purpose: Runs ruff, mypy where the repository configures it, and optionally ruff format in a job that already installs Python.
parts.needs: A job that installs Python; with the suite selection, the first job of a validation workflow, where the verdict reports its result.
